about: FeralX Systems Inc. designs, builds, and delivers defense weapon systems, autonomous platforms, and precision components. Its products include rifles, handguns, pistols, and machine guns; components, including barrels, pistol slides and frames, bolts and bolt carriers, suppressors and muzzle devices, optics mounts and MIL STD-1913 rails, and moulded polymer components; Muskrat, an unmanned ground vehicle; and unmanned aerial systems. It also offers gunsmithing, repair, modification, and functional testing services. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
